function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Here’s a quick guide on where you can order a cake—whether you’re looking for something local, a specialty dessert, or a nationwide delivery:

| Option | What it offers | How to find it | Tips |
|--------|----------------|----------------|------|
| **Local bakeries & patisseries** | Fresh, often handmade cakes; great for custom designs | Google “cake shop near me” or use Yelp / TripAdvisor | Check opening hours, ask about delivery or pickup, read recent reviews |
| **Specialty cake shops** | Signature flavors, themed cakes (e.g., wedding, birthday, vegan, gluten‑free) | Search “specialty cake shop” + city name | Call ahead for custom orders; confirm flavor availability |
| **National cake delivery services** | Nationwide coverage, same‑day delivery in many areas | Examples: <https://www.baker.com>, <https://www.cakeboss.com>, <https://www.treats.com> | Look for “same‑day delivery” filters; compare shipping fees |
| **Online marketplaces** | Multiple vendors in one place (e.g., Etsy, Amazon Handmade) | Search “custom cake” on Etsy or Amazon | Read seller ratings, check return policies, confirm shipping times |
| **Food‑delivery apps** | Quick ordering via UberEats, DoorDash, Grubhub, Postmates | Open app → search “cakes” or “desserts” | Use filters for “delivery” and “rating”; check delivery time estimates |
| **Grocery stores with bakery sections** | Convenient pick‑up or curbside | Check store website or call | Ask about special orders; confirm pickup window |
| **Catering companies** | Ideal for events, bulk orders | Search “event catering” + city | Request samples, discuss dietary restrictions, confirm delivery logistics |

### How to choose the right option

1. **Define your needs**  
   * **Occasion** – Birthday, wedding, corporate event, etc.  
   * **Size** – Number of servings, height, shape.  
   * **Flavor & dietary restrictions** – Gluten‑free, vegan, nut‑free, etc.

2. **Check delivery options**  
   * Same‑day vs. next‑day delivery.  
   * Delivery radius (some local shops only deliver within a few miles).  
   * Delivery fees and minimum order amounts.

3. **Read reviews & look at photos**  
   * Verify quality and reliability.  
   * Pay attention to comments about packaging and on‑time delivery.

4. **Ask about customization**  
   * Many shops allow you to upload a photo or describe a design.  
   * Confirm how long it takes to create a custom cake.

5. **Confirm payment & cancellation policy**  
   * Some sites require full payment upfront; others accept partial deposits.  
   * Know the refund or reschedule policy in case plans change.

---

#### Quick start: Try these websites first

| Website | What they specialize in | Why it might suit you |
|---------|------------------------|-----------------------|
| **Baker.com** | Custom cakes, wedding cakes, seasonal specials | User-friendly interface, same‑day delivery in many cities |
| **CakeBoss.com** | Premium cakes, themed designs | Great for upscale events, offers gift wrapping |
| **Treats.com** | Wide variety of desserts, including cakes | Good for last‑minute orders, offers free shipping over $50 |
| **Etsy** | Artisan, handmade cakes from independent bakers | Unique designs, supports small businesses |
| **Amazon Handmade** | Curated selection of handmade goods | Fast shipping, reliable customer service |

If you let me know your city or zip code, I can narrow down the best local options for you!
